env.name: ADB_PATH
env.description: Path to adb binary. Default: 'adb' on PATH.

env.name: ANDROID_HOME
env.description: Android SDK root. Used to resolve adb if ADB_PATH not set.

env.name: ANDROID_SERIAL
env.description: Default device serial when multiple devices are connected.

env.name: ANDROID_TOOLS
env.description: Comma-separated category allowlist. Default: all categories enabled.

env.name: ANDROID_MCP_ALLOW_SHELL
env.description: Set to 'true' to enable arbitrary shell command execution. Default disabled.

env.name: ANDROID_MCP_ALLOW_WRITE
env.description: Set to 'true' to enable write/destructive tools. Default read-only.
